usage: 皮帶 is a noun and refers to a belt used to hold up pants or as a fashion accessory.
You can say '戴皮帶' (wear a belt) when talking about putting on a belt.
皮帶 can come in different materials like leather or fabric, so you might describe it with adjectives.
You can ask about the color or style of a 皮帶 when shopping, e.g., '有冇黑色嘅皮帶？' (Do you have a black belt?).
